title: Dev's Totem Poles
description: This mod adds an early/mid-game equivalent of beacons in Totems/Totem poles
body:
This mod adds Early/Mid-game equivalents to beacons in 10 seperate totem poles, which give specific boons based on the type of totem pole.

1. Rabbit/Spruce - Luck

2. Cow/Birch - Health Boost

3. Pig/Jungle - Regeneration

4. Sheep/Acacia - Saturation

5. Chicken/Oak - Speed

6. Bee/Dark Oak - Levitation

7. Goat/Cherry - Strength

8. Frog/Mangrove - Jump Boost

9. Enderman/Warped - Night Vision

10. Piglin/Crimson - Haste
